A Beacon of Hope and Compassionate Care

I recently had the opportunity to visit PD hospital in Virar and I was deeply moved by the experience. This hospital is not just a medical facility—it’s a lifeline for countless people in need. Operated as a charitable trust, their mission to serve the underprivileged with quality healthcare is truly inspiring.

What sets this hospital apart is its unwavering commitment to humanity. Patients who cannot afford treatment are never turned away. Instead, they are given the same quality of care and attention as anyone else.

In a world where healthcare is often out of reach for so many, [Hospital Name] is a shining example of what it means to care. Monsoon Wellness Guide: Stay Healthy This Rainy Season

The monsoon season brings much-needed relief from the heat, but it also increases the risk of infections, seasonal illnesses, and weakened immunity. A few simple lifestyle changes can help you stay healthy and enjoy the rains without worry.

Start by maintaining good hygiene. Wash your hands regularly, especially before meals and after returning home. Avoid staying in wet clothes for long periods, as dampness can lead to infections and colds. Ensure you get adequate sleep and stay physically active to support your immune system.

Your diet plays an important role too. Choose freshly cooked meals, include seasonal fruits rich in vitamins, and stay hydrated with warm water, herbal teas, and nutritious soups. Avoid unhygienic street food during the rainy season.

Most importantly, pay attention to your health and seek medical advice if symptoms persist. At Prakriti Hospital, we encourage everyone to make smart choices and enjoy a healthier, safer monsoon season

The Hidden Risk Factors for Oral, Head & Neck Cancer

When people think about oral, head, and neck cancers, tobacco and alcohol are often considered the main causes. While they are significant risk factors, they are not the only ones. Many people are unaware that these cancers can also develop due to HPV (Human Papillomavirus) infection, prolonged sun exposure, poor oral hygiene, unhealthy dietary habits, and genetic factors.

Early signs may include persistent mouth ulcers, difficulty swallowing, a lump in the neck, hoarseness of voice, unexplained bleeding, or white and red patches inside the mouth. Unfortunately, these symptoms are often ignored until the disease progresses.

The good news is that early detection can significantly improve treatment outcomes. Regular dental check-ups, maintaining good oral hygiene, avoiding tobacco products, limiting alcohol consumption, and seeking medical advice for any unusual symptoms can help reduce the risk.

At Prakriti Hospital, we encourage awareness, prevention, and timely screening. Understanding the risk factors beyond tobacco and alcohol can help protect your health and support early diagnosis when it matters most.

Healthy Habits Start With Small Changes

In today’s digital world, spending long hours on phones, laptops, and screens has become part of everyday life. But excessive screen time can silently affect both physical and mental health. Eye strain, poor posture, low energy levels, sleep disturbances, and difficulty concentrating are common signs that your body may need rest and better daily habits.

Late-night scrolling and sitting for long hours without breaks can impact sleep quality, increase stress, and cause neck or back discomfort over time. The good news is that small lifestyle changes can make a big difference. Taking short breaks, stretching regularly, maintaining proper posture, limiting screen time before bed, and getting enough sleep can help improve overall well-being.

At Prakriti Hospital, we encourage healthy daily habits that support long-term health. Remember, better health doesn’t always require big changes — sometimes, small mindful steps are enough to create a healthier lifestyle.

Are Sugary Drinks Really Hydrating You?

When the heat rises, many people reach for cold drinks thinking they help with hydration. However, not all drinks are as beneficial as they seem. Sugary beverages like sodas, packaged juices, and energy drinks can actually do the opposite—leading to increased dehydration. High sugar content pulls water from your body, making you feel more thirsty over time.

True hydration comes from simple, effective choices. Water remains the best way to keep your body balanced, regulate temperature, and support overall health. Adding natural options like coconut water or fresh fruit-infused water can also help maintain hydration levels without excess sugar.

If you often feel tired, dizzy, or dehydrated, your drink choices could be a contributing factor. Small changes in daily habits can make a big difference.

At Prakriti Hospital, we encourage mindful lifestyle choices for better health. Choose wisely—your body will thank you.

Is Your Body Struggling with Sudden Temperature Changes?

Your body constantly adapts to changing environments—but sudden temperature shifts can put extra stress on your system. Moving from a cold office environment to intense outdoor heat can lead to fatigue, dehydration, headaches, and even heat-related illnesses.

When your body struggles to adjust, it’s a sign that it needs better care and balance. Staying hydrated, maintaining proper nutrition, and avoiding extreme temperature exposure can help your body cope better. Simple habits like drinking enough water, taking short breaks, and dressing appropriately for the weather can make a big difference.

If you frequently feel tired, dizzy, or uncomfortable during such transitions, it’s important not to ignore these signals. Your body is trying to tell you something.

At Prakriti Hospital, we believe prevention is key. Regular health check-ups and expert guidance can help you stay strong and resilient in every season.

70% of health problems 
can be prevented with regular checkups.

Regular health check-ups play a vital role in maintaining overall well-being and preventing serious illnesses. Studies suggest that nearly 70% of health problems can be avoided or managed effectively with timely screenings and early detection. 
Many conditions such as diabetes, hypertension, thyroid disorders, and heart diseases develop silently without noticeable symptoms in the early stages.

Routine check-ups help identify these issues before they become severe, allowing for timely treatment and better outcomes. They also provide an opportunity to assess your lifestyle, nutrition, and overall health risks, helping you make informed decisions for a healthier future.

At Prakriti Hospital, we emphasize preventive care through comprehensive health screenings tailored to your needs. Our experienced medical team ensures accurate diagnosis, guidance, and personalized care plans.

Don’t wait for symptoms to appear. Prioritize your health today with regular check-ups and take a proactive step towards a healthier, longer life. Prevention is always better than cure.

Always Feeling Tired? It May Be More Than Just Laziness

Constant tiredness is often dismissed as stress, lack of sleep, or a busy lifestyle. However, if you frequently feel exhausted even after adequate rest, it could indicate an underlying health concern. Persistent fatigue may be linked to conditions such as low hemoglobin (anemia), thyroid imbalance, vitamin deficiencies, or hormonal changes in the body.

These health issues can silently affect your energy levels, concentration, mood, and overall well-being. Identifying the root cause through proper medical evaluation is essential to restore your health and vitality. Early diagnosis and timely treatment can help prevent complications and improve your quality of life.

At Prakriti Hospital, our specialists focus on understanding the cause behind your fatigue through comprehensive health screening and personalized care. If you often feel tired without a clear reason, it’s important not to ignore the signs.

Listen to your body. Sometimes, tiredness is your body asking for medical attention.

Weight gain is not always about food alone. In many cases, stress plays a bigger role than we realize. Chronic stress increases cortisol levels, which can lead to increased cravings, emotional eating, poor sleep, and fat storage—especially around the abdomen. Instead of starting another extreme diet, it’s important to focus on balance.

At Prakriti Hospital, we believe in a holistic approach to healthy weight management. This includes identifying hidden nutrient deficiencies, balancing carbohydrates, proteins, and fats properly, understanding the difference between real hunger and emotional cravings, and correcting portion sizes without starvation or crash diets. Sustainable habits always work better than short-term restrictions.

Building a healthy eating routine combined with stress management techniques like proper sleep, physical activity, and mindful eating can create long-lasting results. Your body needs nourishment, not punishment.

If you’re struggling with weight despite dieting, it may be time to look deeper. Consult our experts to create a personalized plan that supports both your physical and mental well-being.

If you truly care about your loved one’s life, please do not take them to Sanjivani Hospital. Getting admitted there almost feels like receiving a death certificate instead of a discharge card.

Families are misled and financially exploited in the name of treatment.

I have never seen a hospital as irresponsible, unprofessional, and dangerous as this one.
Please, for the safety of your loved ones, do not admit them to Sanjivani Hospital.

featured_reviews.name: Sanjog Mohite
featured_reviews.review_text:
*PD Hospital – Virar West*

I recently had my check‑up at PD Hospital and left feeling truly impressed. From the moment I walked in, the front‑desk team greeted me with warm smiles and sorted everything out in a flash. The doctors took plenty of time to explain my results, answered every question, and showed genuine concern for my well‑being.

The nursing staff were outstanding—attentive, gentle, and always ready with a reassuring word. Their professionalism and caring attitude made what could have been a stressful visit completely comfortable.

What really stands out is the clean, well‑maintained environment; every corner felt hygienic and safe. The overall service runs smoothly, and the entire team works together like a well‑oiled machine, consistently exceeding expectations . ¹

If you’re looking for a reliable hospital in Virar West, PD Hospital is a top choice. Highly recommended!

Special thanks:
Dr. Abhishek Pandit performed my cataract surgery at PD Hospital, Virar West, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. From the pre‑op consultation he explained every step clearly and answered all my questions, which eased my anxiety. During the operation his steady hands and meticulous technique made the procedure painless, and the post‑op care from his team was attentive and reassuring. Within a few days my vision was noticeably sharper, and there were no complications. I highly recommend Dr. Pandit for anyone considering cataract surgery—his expertise, professionalism, and genuine compassion make a huge difference.

featured_reviews.name: Rocky Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing to express my concern regarding an incident that occurred on the night of 4th August. I was seated in the waiting area when a staff member informed me that sitting there was not allowed. I politely asked if there was any signage or notice stating that patient relatives cannot sit in that area, but the staff did not provide an answer. I then raised the same question to the doctor, and he also confirmed that no such notice was displayed.

Additionally, I observed that the same area was being used by staff to dry clothes. When I asked the doctor if it was a designated drying area, I did not receive any response.

In another instance, I noticed that in the general ward, where it is clearly marked as a “male ward,” 3 out of 4 beds were occupied by female patients. This causes confusion and raises concerns for other patients and their relatives.

I kindly request the management to provide clarity on where patient relatives are expected to sit, especially during night hours. If certain areas are restricted, please consider placing clear signage and arranging a proper seating area for relatives.
